decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory tied closely to the core trailer range, it is still worth keeping unless several years of muted demand clearly justify cleaning up the assortment.
A box trailer series sits squarely in the firm's core business, so even with limited recent visibility the option value of retaining an established mainstream line remains positive.
The car transporter line is more specialized and likely costlier to support, and after several years the firm would have learned enough to exit if strong demand had not materialized.
Low-bed trailers fit the firm's capabilities and customer base well, so management would usually continue this core-type series rather than abandon it.
A high trailer cover series complements existing trailer sales and is relatively inexpensive to maintain, which favors keeping the option open.
Because this is another box trailer series overlapping with Product B, the firm has a strong incentive by now to rationalize the portfolio and free resources for stronger lines.
